title: 연구학교에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20080304:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology and Its Affiliated Institutions <Ordinance No. 1, March 4, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Articles 2 through 4
Omitted.
Article 5 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (27) Omitted.
(28) Part of the Rules on Research Schools shall be amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1), (3), and (5), the latter sentence of Article 5 (1), Article 5 (2), Article 7, and Article 9, "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development" shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Education, Science and Technology".
(29) through (63) Omitted.
